02 / Ages & stages

Choose an age group

A little more
about each age.

These guides are conversation starters, not a claim about a specific curriculum or daily schedule.

01

First little moments

Infants0–11 months

A new beginning comes with lots of questions. Reach out about comfort, feeding, rest, and how to plan for a smooth introduction.

Good questions to bring

  • What supplies would you like families to bring?
  • How do feeding and rest arrangements work?
  • How are parents updated during the day?
Ask about this age group
02

Curiosity in motion

Toddlers12–23 months

Toddlers are discovering their voices, routines, and independence. Ask the team what an age-appropriate day looks like for your little one.

Good questions to bring

  • What is the routine for toddlers?
  • How do you help with drop-off transitions?
  • What should families know about mealtimes and naps?
Ask about this age group
03

Questions, stories & wonder

Preschool2–4 years

The preschool years open up new ways to connect and explore. Ask about activities, communication, and routines for this age group.

Good questions to bring

  • What kinds of activities are available?
  • How are daily routines communicated?
  • How can families prepare for the first week?
Ask about this age group
04

Room to keep growing

School-age5 years & older

School-age care is listed in the state record. Check with the center about age eligibility, hours, school-day arrangements, and availability.

Good questions to bring

  • Which school-age schedules are offered?
  • Are transportation or school-day arrangements available?
  • How do enrollment and availability work for this age?
Ask about this age group

Ages are based on the Oklahoma licensing listing. Availability and schedules may differ by age; ask the center for current information.
